observations: Photos show multiple used tires stacked in a shop/warehouse; the exact tire(s) being sold are not clearly isolated.
In photo 0, a tire is visible in the foreground with tread grooves; no clear sidewall brand/model text is readable.
In photo 1, a tire in the foreground shows tread and sidewall, but no readable brand/model or DOT/size markings.
In photo 2, another foreground tire is visible; again, no readable brand/model/size/DOT markings.
No close-up photos of the specific tire’s sidewall damage, patches, or bulges are provided.

identity.kind: used car tires (exact size/brand not readable)

claims.evidence: No readable branding/labeling or business proof in the photos; only stacked tires are shown.
Photos show tread depth/grooves but do not provide a measurable tread-depth gauge or clear close-up of the specific tire’s wear.
No close-up of the sidewall and tread surface of the exact tire is shown to confirm absence of patches or bulges.
No DOT date code or documentation is readable in the photos to support the 2023 claim.

risks.risk: Exact tire identification (size/brand/model) is not readable, so the wrong tire could be priced/selected.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tire sidewall showing size (e.g., 195/65R15), brand/model text, and DOT code.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used tires with unknown size/brand and assume worst-case fit/unknown spec.

risks.risk: Tread depth claim ("90 percent") may be overstated; wear could be uneven or near end-of-life.
risks.proof: Close-up of the specific tire tread plus a tread-depth measurement (tread gauge) at 3–4 points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not at 90% (worst case: meaning closer to average used tread).

risks.risk: No patch/no bulge may be false; internal damage or sidewall bulges may not be visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the entire sidewall and tread surface of the exact tire, plus a photo of the inside (inner liner) if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially defective/unknown condition (worst case: treat as not guaranteed patch/bulge-free).

risks.risk: Age claim ("2023 car") may be wrong; tires could be older based on DOT date.
risks.proof: Clear DOT date code photo on the sidewall (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tires (worst case for age/condition).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the exact tire sidewall showing: size, brand/model text, and DOT date code.
Send close-up photos of the exact tire tread and both sidewalls (front/back), ensuring any patch area or bulge would be visible.
Provide tread-depth measurements (in mm) at multiple points on the exact tire using a tread gauge.
response.reason: The photos do not clearly identify the exact tire (size/brand/DOT) and do not provide decisive evidence for tread depth, patch/bulge absence, or 2023 origin; without that, a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently matched.
